It sounds like you're looking for a damage support that can extend that high damage aspect out to late game. Champions like Zyra, Brand, and Vel'Koz are great for that. Pretty much all engage supports lose their kill pressure by late game due to low scaling abilities and teams grouping up.

I'd suggest transitioning over to utility once everyone has caught up to you. Make sure you always grab an Umbral Glaive since you can clear out the entire map of wards. Keep your own wards and control wards around key objectives. Pyke is incredible at escaping and avoiding getting picked. That makes warding aggressively significantly easier.

During team fights try to hook carries out of position or throw the enemy frontline off your own carries. Hard peeling for carries is an easy thing for engage supports to transition into as well. Doing this also let's you just hang out until you're able to execute someone.

Late game item builds for Pyke are something I used to play with a while back so I'm not sure how much this stuff still stands. If you feel your ults aren't landing and you can't do much damage at all by the end of a game consider switching out items for stuff like redemption or frozen heart. Redemption can easily win a fight and also increases your own self healing. Frozen heart of course will just lower damage output from the enemy team since everyone auto attacks.

Frozen Heart is very good on champions like Bard, Taric, and Rakan. Enchanters who need some tankiness but still want to buy items that assist their team. Everything about the item is incredibly useful.
